text: For #902: a Needs you card's wait counts from the factory's post, or from when its pull request last changed if that's later, which is the pull request's last update or the latest start or end of its gate's runs on its head. So a card whose gate has passed since the post, or whose pull request was pushed to, is with what's new and is counted in what needs a person, and isn't folded with what has waited more than two days. A retry that waits on CI's gate is labeled without "once CI passes" once the gate has passed on the head and the pull request is open and can merge, a draft included, since the factory marks a draft ready. Where a card says what its pull request is now, what the factory said when it stopped is dated. On 2026-11-13 a pull request in another repository waited twelve hours ready to merge, its card folded under "Nothing new needs you", and its words still said CI had failed.
